args.title: Update README.md to replace 'npm run serve' with the correct build-and-start command
args.body:
File: README.md

The "Running locally" section instructs users to run `npm run serve` after building, but this script does not exist. Instead, the correct command to start the API after building is already listed as `npm run build` followed by `npm run start`. The README should replace `npm run serve` with `npm run start` to match the actual available scripts and avoid confusion for new contributors.
